title: Ma-Ka-Ja-Wan Scout Reservation

services.name: Adult Summer Camp
services.desc: A full week at Ma-Ka-Ja-Wan-no schedules, no responsabilities, just the best parts of camp. It's a week designed for adults who remember what made camp great and want to experience it again. This is not traditional summer camp. No merit badges. No packed schedules. No expectations.
